headline: Self-Credit uses cross-rollout turn citations to assign credit in long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning
summary: The arXiv preprint introduces Self-Credit, a long-horizon agentic RL method that has a policy cite earlier turns in its own summaries, then adjusts turn-level credit by comparing cited actions across successful and failed rollouts for each prompt. Across three-seed evaluations, the authors report higher accuracy than the strongest tested agentic-RL baselines on BrowseComp-Plus with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B, and on GAIA and xBench-DeepSearch with Gemma4-E4B. Evaluation relies on LLM-as-judge scoring; independent reproduction and end-to-end compute comparison are not established.
